verdict.rationale: cubic documents on-demand triggering through PR comments (`@cubic-dev-ai review this PR`, tagging the bot to trigger reviews) and repository selection at install. Otherwise it reviews new PRs automatically, and nothing in the pack shows draft-skipping or branch/label filtering. cubic.yaml covers "AI review behavior, ignore patterns", but the pack does not show those patterns gate when reviews run. missing for 10: documented skip-draft-PR setting, branch-based review filters, label-based review filters, option to disable auto-review in favor of on-demand only, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I control when reviews run — skip drafts, trigger on demand, filter by branch or label — so the bot shows up only when wanted

citations.quote: Interact with cubic in PR comments to ask questions, trigger reviews, and fix issues. You can tag `@cubic-dev-ai` directly
